valuation.drawdown_bounds: For a price-equity group with minimum L and maximum H and preceding peak P: lower-DD candidate=max(0,P-L); upper-DD candidate=max(0,max(P,H)-L). Carry P=max(P,H); retain max candidates across groups. At forced single pre-fill points use L=H=equity. This is absolute-USDT observed bound under the explicit group model; no percentage or exact DD claim without separate proof.
valuation.end: Terminal cash with inventory exactly zero must reconcile to capital+gross_price_pnl+funding-sum(all costs).
valuation.post_fill_points: After all inventory/cash changes at this group, emit L/H with same inventory and scenario cash state; never permute a cost or fill transition among valuation observations.
valuation.valuation: At each timestamp group, cash+inventory_btc*each distinct observed trade price. Initial capital and each forced pre-fill equity point are single ordered points. Unknown same-timestamp price sequence gives a bounded observed trade valuation DD, not official mark or continuous risk.

rules.entry: Entry direction=1; first timestamp group of each fixed entry second; buy highest/sell lowest; One prescribed slice per each of 60 fixed UTC seconds: sliceLots[k]=floor((k+1)*100/60)-floor(k*100/60); 20 one-lot and 40 two-lot slices, BTC per lot0.0001, entry/exit identical. In each scheduled second select first observed timestamp group and use highest price for purchase/lowest for sale. At least one group required in every scheduled second.
rules.exit: 60 seconds [00:10,00:11); identical lots; reverse sign, buy highest/sell lowest first group price
rules.quantity_or_inventory: ctVal=0.01 BTC/contract; lotSz=minSz=0.01 contract; BTC per lot=0.0001. sliceLots[k]=floor((k+1)*100/60)-floor(k*100/60), k=0..59; exactly 20 one-lot and 40 two-lot slices sum to 100 lots=0.01 BTC. Entry and exit use same fixed sequence.
rules.signal: Fixed counterfactual exposure, no data-selected signal
rules.termination: 2026-10-03T00:11:00Z; q exactly zero, all costs and groups reconciled
